sentences.translation: 拉齐.贾米尔是拉合尔的桑贾恩.纳加尔哲学和艺术研究所的音乐理论家。 他说，迈克尔.杰克逊影响了巴基斯坦的流行歌坛，这点是毫无疑问的。

sentences.sentence: But the joke would be lost on some: the Canadian-American musicologist Colin McPhee, who spent several years on Bali in the 1930s, recalls a young boy who showed great talent for dancing.
sentences.translation: 但是在一些语言中就失去了它的幽默效果：加拿大裔美国的音乐学家，柯林.麦柯菲曾于20世纪30年代在巴里度过几年的时光，提到了在那里一位对舞蹈有极高天分的少年。

sentences.sentence: One-story homes that are "tied together" -- with the roof bolted to the walls and the walls to the foundation -- tend to survive earthquakes and windstorms better than multistory homes that aren't.

sentences.sentence: For example, you may not think a bagel tastes salty, but a typical 4-inch (10-centimeter) oat-bran bagel has about 532 mg of sodium, and even a slice of whole-wheat bread contains 132 mg of sodium.

sentences.sentence: So it appears that banks do an unusually lousy job of differentiating themselves.
sentences.translation: 如此看来，银行业者通常在区分自己的工作上太过糟糕。

sentences.sentence: A model may contain hundreds of artifacts, so we might need ways of grouping them or differentiating a few symbols from the others.
sentences.translation: 一个模型可能包含了数百个工件，这样我们可能需要将它们分组的方法，或者从其他的符号中进行一些区别。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 425 单元

lore
音标：英 /lɔː/  美 /lɔr/
n. 学问,（动物的）眼光知识
例句：According to local lore, a ghost still haunts the castle.
根据当地人的传说，城堡里至今仍然闹鬼。

adjoin
音标：英 /ə'dʒɒɪn/  美 /ə'dʒɔɪn/
v. 邻接, 毗连
例句：A vacant plot of land adjoins his house.
有一块空地紧挨着他家。

mortar
音标：英 /'mɔːtə/  美 /'mɔrtɚ/
n. 灰泥,迫击炮 vt用灰泥结合
短语：cement mortar — 水泥砂浆；水泥灰浆
短语：dry mortar — 干灰浆；稠砂浆
短语：polymer mortar — 聚合物灰浆
短语：lime mortar — 石灰砂浆
短语：brick and mortar — 实体的；砖块和灰浆
短语：resin mortar — 诗灰浆；树脂胶浆；树脂砂浆
例句：A cameraman was killed when his vehicle came under mortar fire .
一名摄影师因所乘坐的汽车遭到迫击炮袭击而丧生。
例句：a mortar attack
迫击炮轰击

incongruity
音标：英 /,ɪnkɒŋ'gruːɪtɪ/  美 /,ɪnkɑŋ'grʊəti/
n. 不调和的, 不适宜的
例句：The incongruity of her situation struck Gina with unpleasant force.
吉娜猛然意识到自己处境尴尬，心里很不舒服。

tableland
音标：英 /'teɪb(ə)llænd/  美 /'tebllænd/
n. 高原
例句：The northwestern tableland area has a continental plateau climate with long and chilly winter and cool humid summer.
西北高原地区是大陆高原气候，有漫长而寒冷的冬季，凉爽而湿润的夏季。
例句：Few of tropical Africa's rivers are navigable from the ocean, dropping as they do from interior tableland to coastal plains by a series of falls and rapids.
酷热的非洲，几乎没有适于航海的河流，这些河流从内陆高原到海岸平原一路穿瀑布、过险滩，倾流而下。

perfection
音标：英 /pə'fekʃ(ə)n/  美 /pɚ'fɛkʃən/
n. 尽善尽美, 完美, 完成
例句：My father expected perfection from all of us.
父亲期望我们都尽善尽美。
例句：the search for technical perfection
对技术的精益求精

fullness
音标：英 /'fʊlnɪs/  美 /'fʊlnəs/
n. 满, 丰富, 成熟
例句：Use a red gloss on your bottom lip to give it fullness.
下唇使用红色唇彩让它显得丰盈饱满。

recoil
音标：英 /rɪ'kɒɪl/  美 /'rikɔɪl/
n. 畏缩, 弹回 vi退却, 畏缩
短语：recoil from — 畏缩，后退
短语：recoil force — n. 反冲力；坐后力
例句：...his small body jerking in recoil from the volume of his shouting.
…他小小身体在他大声的叫喊中畏缩地抽搐着。

musicologist
n. 音乐学者
例句：Rakae Jamil, a musicologist with the Sanjan Nagar Institute of Philosophy and Arts in Lahore, says there is no doubt that Michael Jackson influenced the pop scene in Pakistan.
拉齐.贾米尔是拉合尔的桑贾恩.纳加尔哲学和艺术研究所的音乐理论家。 他说，迈克尔.杰克逊影响了巴基斯坦的流行歌坛，这点是毫无疑问的。
例句：But the joke would be lost on some: the Canadian-American musicologist Colin McPhee, who spent several years on Bali in the 1930s, recalls a young boy who showed great talent for dancing.
但是在一些语言中就失去了它的幽默效果：加拿大裔美国的音乐学家，柯林.麦柯菲曾于20世纪30年代在巴里度过几年的时光，提到了在那里一位对舞蹈有极高天分的少年。
例句：Authority as a critic and as a musicologist was fully recognized.
权威评论家和音乐学家的充分承认。

forte
音标：英 /'fɔːteɪ; 'fɔːtɪ; fɔːt/  美 /'fɔrte/
n. 长处
例句：He found that running long distances was not his forte .
他发现长跑并不是他的强项。
例句：As a writer, her forte is comedy.
作为作家，她的专长是写喜剧。

percussive
音标：英 /pə'kʌsɪv/  美 /pɚ'kʌsɪv/
adj. 冲击的,叩诊的
短语：percussive drilling — 冲击钻探
例句：...using all manner of percussive effects.
...运用各种打击乐效果。

multistory
adj. 多层的,有多层楼的
例句：The abbey was a maze of multistory wings, each added in a differing century, the architecture conspiring to create a jumbled complex that now housed four hundred brothers.
修道院的结构是迷宫似的多层侧翼，每个侧翼都在不同的世纪里被添上，那建筑拼成一混乱的复合体，里面现在住着四百多个圣殿武士。
例句：One-story homes that are "tied together" -- with the roof bolted to the walls and the walls to the foundation -- tend to survive earthquakes and windstorms better than multistory homes that aren't.
单层的楼房就像“绑在一起”--屋顶，墙和地基连成一体，它抗击地震和风暴的能力比多层的楼房要高得多。

hammerhead
音标：英 /'hæməhed/  美 /'hæmɚhɛd/
n. 锤头 a锤头状的, 鲁钝的

induct
音标：英 /ɪn'dʌkt/  美 /ɪn'dʌkt/
v. 感应,引导
例句：The government shoulders ethic obligation, she has to induct and maintain the rationalization of the living world.
政府在生活世界中引导和维护生活世界的合理化，肩负著伦理责任；

coincident
音标：英 /kəʊ'ɪnsɪd(ə)nt/  美 /ko'ɪnsɪdənt/
adj. 一致的,符合的
例句：Their aims are coincident with ours.
他们的目标和我们的一致。

assort
音标：英 /ə'sɔːt/  美 /ə'sɔrt/
v. 分类配全
短语：assort with — v. 相称；与…协调

forgiveness
音标：英 /fə'gɪvnɪs/  美 /fɚ'ɡɪvnəs/
n. 宽恕, 宽仁之心
例句：...a spirit of forgiveness and national reconciliation.
…一种宽恕与民族和解的精神。

spoonful
音标：英 /'spuːnfʊl/  美 /'spʊn'fʊl/
n. 一匙
例句：He took a spoonful of the stew and ate it.
他舀起一匙炖菜吃了下去。

oat
音标：英 /əʊt/  美 /ot/
n. [植]燕麦, 麦片粥
短语：oat bran — 燕麦麸
短语：wild oat — 小颚花；野生燕麦
例句：Instead of eating hunched pleasurably over a book, I look out of the window and chew every mouthful thoroughly, aware of every single oat and nut and dried bit of apple as it goes down.
送孩子们去学校后，我不再放松地边吃早饭边看书，而是盯着窗外，仔细地嚼着嘴里的食物：每一粒燕麦、每一颗坚果、每一片苹果干。
例句：For example, you may not think a bagel tastes salty, but a typical 4-inch (10-centimeter) oat-bran bagel has about 532 mg of sodium, and even a slice of whole-wheat bread contains 132 mg of sodium.
例如百吉饼或许尝起来不咸，但一块普普通通的4英寸（10厘米）大的燕麦百吉饼却含将近532毫克的钠，而且即便一小块全麦面包也有132毫克钠。

differentiating
音标：英 /,dɪfə'renʃɪ,eɪtɪŋ/  美 /,dɪfə'rɛnʃɪ,etɪŋ/
adj. 微分的
短语：differentiate from — 将…区别开来
例句：So it appears that banks do an unusually lousy job of differentiating themselves.
如此看来，银行业者通常在区分自己的工作上太过糟糕。
例句：A model may contain hundreds of artifacts, so we might need ways of grouping them or differentiating a few symbols from the others.
一个模型可能包含了数百个工件，这样我们可能需要将它们分组的方法，或者从其他的符号中进行一些区别。
typingText:
According to local lore, a ghost still haunts the castle.

A vacant plot of land adjoins his house.

A cameraman was killed when his vehicle came under mortar fire .

a mortar attack

The incongruity of her situation struck Gina with unpleasant force.

The northwestern tableland area has a continental plateau climate with long and chilly winter and cool humid summer.

Few of tropical Africa's rivers are navigable from the ocean, dropping as they do from interior tableland to coastal plains by a series of falls and rapids.

My father expected perfection from all of us.

the search for technical perfection

Use a red gloss on your bottom lip to give it fullness.

...his small body jerking in recoil from the volume of his shouting.

Rakae Jamil, a musicologist with the Sanjan Nagar Institute of Philosophy and Arts in Lahore, says there is no doubt that Michael Jackson influenced the pop scene in Pakistan.

But the joke would be lost on some: the Canadian-American musicologist Colin McPhee, who spent several years on Bali in the 1930s, recalls a young boy who showed great talent for dancing.

Authority as a critic and as a musicologist was fully recognized.

He found that running long distances was not his forte .

As a writer, her forte is comedy.

...using all manner of percussive effects.

The abbey was a maze of multistory wings, each added in a differing century, the architecture conspiring to create a jumbled complex that now housed four hundred brothers.

One-story homes that are "tied together" -- with the roof bolted to the walls and the walls to the foundation -- tend to survive earthquakes and windstorms better than multistory homes that aren't.

hammerhead

The government shoulders ethic obligation, she has to induct and maintain the rationalization of the living world.

Their aims are coincident with ours.

assort

...a spirit of forgiveness and national reconciliation.

He took a spoonful of the stew and ate it.

Instead of eating hunched pleasurably over a book, I look out of the window and chew every mouthful thoroughly, aware of every single oat and nut and dried bit of apple as it goes down.

For example, you may not think a bagel tastes salty, but a typical 4-inch (10-centimeter) oat-bran bagel has about 532 mg of sodium, and even a slice of whole-wheat bread contains 132 mg of sodium.

So it appears that banks do an unusually lousy job of differentiating themselves.

A model may contain hundreds of artifacts, so we might need ways of grouping them or differentiating a few symbols from the others.
